description: Colour control strip (pdfnative 1.8 via generate_basic_pdf v1.7.0): `print.marks.colourBars` adds the C M Y K solids, their overprints and the 75 / 50 / 25 % tints in the bleed, beside the crop and registration marks. It is off by default — existing `marks` output is unchanged — and needs room: a bleed of about 5 mm (14.17 pt); the strip is skipped silently when it would not fit. Pass `{ tints: false }` for solids only or `{ size: 8 }` for smaller patches. Self-contained: runs end-to-end with no placeholders.

blocks.text: The strip in the bleed lets the press operator check ink density and tone reproduction at a glance.
